name: Zkušební veřejná sada
about: Dvanáct vymyšlených dotazů do banky pro testy PickBench; čtyři štítky, jeden z nich „mimo rozsah“.
about_en: Twelve made-up bank queries for the PickBench tests; four labels, one of them "out of scope".
instructions: Classify the customer query into exactly one intent. Choose oos when no listed intent fits.

labels.description: none of the listed intents; the query is out of scope

items.text: When will my new card arrive?
items.label: card_arrival

items.text: I ordered a card two weeks ago and it is still not here.
items.label: card_arrival

items.text: Is there a tracking number for the card you sent me?
items.label: card_arrival

items.text: How long does card delivery take?
items.label: card_arrival

items.text: What exchange rate do you use for euros?
items.label: exchange_rate

items.text: Is your rate for dollars better on weekdays?
items.label: exchange_rate

items.text: Where can I see today's currency rates?
items.label: exchange_rate

items.text: I lost my card on the train this morning.
items.label: lost_card

items.text: Somebody stole my wallet with the card in it.
items.label: lost_card

items.text: What is the weather like in Prague today?
items.label: oos

items.text: Tell me a joke about cats.
items.label: oos

items.text: How do I bake sourdough bread?
items.label: oos
